details.eligibility: 10th pass (Matriculation) from a recognised board. Age 18-28 years (relaxation as per rules). Physical standards apply - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: CBT: 120 questions, 120 marks, 90 minutes. Negative marking 1/3. Then Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Document Verification and Medical Examination.
details.syllabus: General Awareness (50 Q), Arithmetic (35 Q), General Intelligence & Reasoning (35 Q).
details.important_dates: 2024 cycle CBT held 2-18 Mar 2025. 2018 cycle CBT held Jan-Mar 2019.

notes: ROUND 3 — 2026-11-21. Years by HELD date: the 2024-cycle (CEN RPF 02/2024) CBT was held 2-20 Mar 2025, so it is recorded as 2025 here (round 1 labelled it 2024 by CEN year — do not duplicate). The 2018-cycle CBT was held Jan-Mar 2019 and is covered by round-1 hubs. PET/PMT are physical tests — no question papers exist for them. No official paper PDFs exist: RRB publishes only answer keys/response sheets per CEN on rrbapply.gov.in and regional portals.
